segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: several say it leaves them greasy, shiny, or oilier for hours, while others (including a self-described 'oily skinned person') report no extra oiliness and no breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or very dry skin generally find it non-drying, lightweight, and moisturizing, with one calling it 'not drying to my very dry skin.'
segments.combination: The one combination-skin reviewer, oily-leaning, says it does not cause excess oil or white cast and works well under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report mixed results: several say it doesn't irritate or break them out and call it their holy grail, but others describe stinging eyes, a chemical burn, or a bad reaction.
segments.normal: One reviewer with dry-to-normal skin reports no breakouts and a dewy, non-greasy finish.
segments.mature: One older reviewer reports easy application, quick absorption, and no eye burning, valuing it for added protection with age.

concerns.aging: An older reviewer values it for extra protection and reports easy, non-irritating application; no other aging-specific effects are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Several dry-skin reviewers say it doesn't dry out their face and feels moisturizing; one with easily dry, irritated skin reports no dryness at all.
concerns.redness: One acne-prone reviewer whose face usually reddens with sunscreen says this one does not cause redness; no other redness reports appear.
concerns.barrier: No reviews specifically describe barrier damage or repair from this product.
concerns.spots: Not discussed as a distinct concern separate from blemishes/breakouts in these reviews.
concerns.blemishes: Breakouts are the most divisive point: many acne-prone or oily reviewers report no new breakouts, but several others explicitly blame this sunscreen for new pimples or breakouts, including one who calls it 'making my skin breakout like crazy.'
concerns.oiliness: Oiliness reports split sharply: many call it greasy, heavy, or productive of extra shine (with white pilling balls for some), while an equal number of oily-skin reviewers say it feels lightweight, non-greasy, and leaves no oily cast.

aspects.libelle: Good value for spf and size
